name: 05-any-caller
title: Any caller, any member
purpose: A made-up caller and member ID. In test mode there are no credential blockers, so the agent verifies and answers using invented but believable member data.
lines: Hi, I'm Daniel Ortiz, calling for my mother. Her member ID is NH-310877.
My date of birth is May 12th, 1979.
How many chiropractic visits does she have left, and is Harbor Physical Therapy in network?
